Hi, I’m Pepper! 🐾

I’m an 8 ½ year-old bundle of love with the biggest heart and so much love to give! My foster family says I’m a special girl with a goofy personality, a playful spirit, and a heart that is truly one of a kind.

I may need a little extra patience and understanding when getting to know new people and navigating the world around me. New experiences and unfamiliar dogs can sometimes feel overwhelming, so I’m looking for someone who understands that building trust is a process. I may not open my heart overnight, but when I do, you’ll have a friend who loves with her whole heart. Once I trust you, you’ll get to see the real Pepper - the silly, affectionate, playful girl who loves to snuggle, give kisses, lean in for affection, and make you laugh. I have so much personality packed into this big body, and I truly believe I’m a lap dog! My favorite things include toys, treats, naps, and spending time with my people. And yes, my adorable snoring is just one of my many charms!

I currently live with another female dog, and we have a wonderful relationship. We love to play and chase each other, and she is a very special part of my world. While I do well with my resident dog, I have found that I’m most comfortable in a home where I don’t have to share my people or space with other dogs. I would likely thrive as the only dog in the home, where I can soak up all the love and attention. I’m looking for a quieter home with a patient, compassionate person or family who understands my needs and will give me the time and support I deserve. A female-led home would be a wonderful fit for me, and I would do best without children. I’m hoping for someone who sees the beauty in taking things slowly and understands that the most meaningful relationships are built one day at a time.

My foster family has watched me come so far. I’m learning that the world can be a wonderful place and that new experiences don’t always have to be scary. Every little bit of progress makes us so proud, and we know there is still so much happiness ahead of me. I’m a playful, loving girl who has so much more to discover. I may need someone willing to be patient, but I promise that the love I give in return is worth every moment. Once you become my person, you’ll have a loyal companion who wants nothing more than to be by your side. My foster family loves me dearly, and while saying goodbye will be incredibly difficult, they know there is someone out there who will see just how extraordinary I am.

I’m not looking for a perfect home. I’m looking for the right home - a home with patience, understanding, and a whole lot of heart. If you’re willing to give me the time I need to feel safe and loved, I’ll show you just how much love this big-hearted girl has to give ❤️

We truly love her and we know her perfect family will find her.

Meet Jillian! If you are looking for a pup with a ton of personality and a lot of love, then Jillian is your girl.

With big amber eyes and a uniquely painted coat, Jillian is a showstopper. She loves all humans she meets and is a huge sweetheart, but does need continued boundary work as she thinks the best way to let others know she is a fan is to get right up into their personal space! However, she is smart and has picked up on cues and commands very quickly.

Jillian is crate trained and has done well being crated for longer periods of time while her foster is at work. When crated, she tends to do better in a high-traffic area so she can observe what is going on around her and not miss out. While Jillian has not been left alone in the house outside the crate for long periods of time, during shorter bouts, she has done really well and usually just ends up lounging in the living room or sunroom.

Jillian is also potty-trained. She has cleared our 3-foot fence to go after squirrels so is currently on a lead even with a fenced-in backyard. As an almost 2-year-old, Jillian still has a lot of youthful energy and looks forward to going for her walk first thing in the morning. And while she has made a lot of progress over the last few months, Jillian does have a high prey drive and exhibits some excitable reactivity as a result.

Jillian does express high interest in playing with other dogs but will require monitoring as she does not always appropriately read social cues. Slow introductions are best for her.

In just a short amount of time, Jillian has learned both the verbal and nonverbal signals for “sit”, “wait”, “hands in”, “stay” and “lie down”. She transports well and loves her weekly outdoor adventures at Fort Snelling.

Overall, Jillian's ideal home is with an active family or person who is patient, is in a house (she does have a heavy bark!) with a high fenced-in yard. If you are ready for a lively spirit, funny personality, and unconditional companionship - look no further than Jillian!

Meet Mariska! ❤️

Mariska has been through more than most dogs ever should, but every day she's learning that people can be kind, love can be permanent, and home is a safe place. In 2025, we rescued a litter of her puppies, but we were finally able to rescue her this year. After spending so much of her life surviving and raising babies, this sweet mama is ready to retire, relax, and let someone take care of her for a change.

She's embracing indoor life and making incredible progress. Mariska has discovered the joy of toys and is wonderfully goofy when she plays—leaping, hopping, tossing toys into the air, and catching them herself. She's also incredibly smart! She already knows how to ring the bells to go outside, kennel on cue, sit, leave it, and she's eager to keep learning.

Once Mariska trusts you, she becomes the sweetest little shadow, happily following her favorite person from room to room. A few tasty treats, gentle face scratches, and belly rubs are the fastest way to win her heart. At the end of the day, she's happiest curled up beside you, handing out cuddles and plenty of kisses.

Mariska also enjoys the company of other dogs. She has become friends with every foster dog she's met, but she needs slow, thoughtful introductions and usually takes a day or two to feel comfortable. Because of this, she'd do best in a home that won't expect her to enjoy busy dog parks or daycare settings.

Due to her past, Mariska needs a patient adopter who understands that trust takes time. New people can still be frightening for her, and if she's approached too quickly, she may react out of fear. Her foster family is helping her build confidence, but she'll need someone committed to continuing that journey. For now, she would do best in a home without young children.

When Mariska first entered rescue, she struggled with separation anxiety, barking in her kennel, pawing at the door, or pulling nearby items inside for comfort. She has made tremendous progress, though it's possible some of those behaviors may temporarily return as she adjusts to a new home.

Mariska is looking for someone who will see past her fears and appreciate the incredible dog she's becoming. If you're willing to give her patience, consistency, and unconditional love, she'll reward you with unwavering loyalty, endless affection, and the joy of watching a once-forgotten dog truly blossom into the companion she was always meant to be. ❤️

Tito is suspected to have come to us from a hoarding situation after potentially being bred / a "stud." After a difficult start to life, he is understandably guarded and defensive, and he will need a patient, understanding adopter who is willing to let him build trust at his own pace.

Tito is smart, sassy, independent, and incredibly curious. He’s a bit like a “wisp of smoke”—quick, elusive, and determined to keep all four paws on the ground! He isn’t comfortable being picked up yet, but we’re making progress every day.

He has especially begun to trust his foster mom, choosing to curl up beside her in her recliner. Because of this, we suspect Tito may be more comfortable with women and may need extra time to feel safe around men. He is also gradually warming up to his teenage foster grandsons, showing us that his circle of trust can grow with patience and consistency.

Tito appears to have had little-to-no training before coming into rescue. He is currently pee-pad trained and sleeps quite a bit.

For now, Tito is not a fan of other dogs. He reacts strongly toward the resident dog, so they are kept separated. He is also a significant flight risk and has managed to escape harnesses and take off, so his adopter will need to be extremely careful and use secure, escape-proof equipment and management.

Tito is not going to be an “easy” dog, but he is a worthwhile one. His adopter will need to be committed to giving him time, structure, patience, and plenty of opportunities to learn that the world can be a safe place. In return, they’ll get a smart, savvy, energetic little companion.

Tito is looking for someone who understands that trust isn't given overnight—it’s earned one tiny step at a time. And with Tito, those tiny steps are incredibly rewarding.

Meet Puck! ❤️

If you’re looking for a loyal cuddle buddy, a gentle soul, and a dog who would happily be your copilot on every adventure, Puck might just be your perfect match!

Puck is an incredibly easy companion to welcome into your home. This sweet, affectionate boy is happiest when he’s close to his people, soaking up all the love he can get and giving plenty of kisses in return. While he’s quiet and well-behaved in his kennel, his favorite place is much closer to his humans—preferably curled up beside you on the couch, enjoying some serious cuddle time.

Puck has the most irresistibly big, fluffy, squishy face, and he absolutely LOVES having his cheeks rubbed. ❤️

His foster family has been pleasantly surprised by Puck’s lower energy level, especially considering his breed mix. An Embark DNA test revealed that Puck is an Australian Cattle Dog, Siberian Husky, and German Shepherd mix. Despite those active breeds, Puck isn’t currently interested in running around or playing with the other dogs in his foster home. Instead, you’ll usually find him happily lying near his humans, soaking up their company. He hasn’t shown much interest in toys either, although that may change as he continues to heal, settle in, and gain confidence in his new home.

He is currently living in a foster home with cats. His breed tends to have a higher prey drive and he has shown that, so he would do best in a home without cats.

Puck is still discovering the joys of food and treats and is gradually becoming more food- and bone-motivated. He already knows how to sit and is eager to learn more, especially when it means spending time with his favorite people. Like many happy dogs, he may occasionally jump up when he’s excited to see you, but it’s all out of love.

Nos is a timid young adult who is learning to trust people. He takes a bit of time to warm up, but once he has accepted you, he will follow you everywhere. He has attached himself to our 18-year-old son and is thrilled to hang out and snuggle with him.

Once he’s comfortable with you, Nos soaks up the scratches and attention. He loves to nap on the couch, with his head in your lap. He’s even offered a few tentative kisses in the 24 hours we’ve had him.

Nos is just beginning to decompress and gain confidence in life and his environment. He needs people to be slow and patient with him for now. He doesn’t like to feel like he’s being chased or forced to do something - he’d rather think things are his idea. He will go in a crate and hang out a bit, but will bark if you leave him there. He’s happy to explore in our fenced backyard, but it works best if we open the door and let him head out when he’s ready. This will improve in time; he’s had a lot to figure out in a short amount of time.

He’s not yet interested in playing with the other dogs at our house - because they’re not the dogs he’s used to. But he’s been relatively patient with meeting them.

When Nos meets people, he’s more comfortable when they get down to his level (or sit on a couch), rather than tower over him. He will take a slow sniff, then allow you to pet him. After all, he knows he is darling!

Nos is a beautiful boy! He’s got the sweetest chocolate eyes and super soft fur. With time and patience, he will make a great pet!

Tennessee is a sweet, affectionate young pup who is so happy to have a safe place to call home. She has a medium energy level with bursts of puppy enthusiasm and loves playing with toys, spending time with her people, and hanging out with her dog friends. She’s intelligent, eager to learn, and has already shown that she can listen when redirected.

Tennessee is doing well with house training and is currently going potty outside about 90% of the time. Puppy pads by the door help her when she doesn’t quite make it outside. Like many young dogs, she is still working on her manners and can be mouthy and energetic, but she responds well to a firm “no” and will benefit from continued positive training and consistency.

She gets along well with other dogs and would likely love having a young, playful canine companion to help keep her company and burn off some of that puppy energy. The rare time she barks is to try to encourage the older dogs to play with her. She currently sleeps peacefully on a dog bed alongside her foster dog siblings all night.

Tennessee is interested in cats and wants to play with them a little more enthusiastically than they would prefer! With her young age and trainability, she may be able to learn appropriate manners around cats, but a home with dog-savvy cats and a family committed to supervision and training would be best. She has not been tested with young children, so that would be something to consider carefully.

She is also a mouser! She is smart and very alert and has caught a vole and a mouse in the yard.

She is still learning that meals are going to keep coming, and she tends to gobble her food as though she might not get another chance. Slow feeding and consistency should help her learn that she is safe and cared for.

Tennessee doesn’t seem to be a flight risk and appears incredibly grateful to have a home and people who care for her. She’s a young dog with plenty to learn, but underneath that puppy energy is a loving, intelligent girl who is going to make someone an absolutely wonderful companion.

Tennessee would thrive with a family who is ready to give her the structure, training, patience, and love she needs to become her very best self.

After giving her puppies the love, protection, and guidance they needed, she deserves the chance to be someone's baby now. She’s ready for a family who will continue to help her grow, celebrate her progress, and show her just how wonderful life can be.

Hello! I’m Petey Wheatie and I am an extra special girl looking for an extra special forever home.

In late September, I had a vet appointment and found that my glaucoma was so severe, and causing me so much pain, that both my eyes needed to be removed. I also had much needed dental work done to remove several infected teeth. I am no longer in pain, but it’s been quite an adjustment losing my sight.

While I couldn’t see well before, the complete loss of my vision has been a big adjustment. I am still a very happy girl who loves people and I especially love the quiet safety of my foster mom’s lap while she works.

While I currently live with dogs and a cat, I am easily startled by movement and noise, and can be territorial with my favorite spots, and would do best as an only dog/animal in a home without children and or a lot activity.

True to my breed, I am a vocal girl and like to communicate when I am excited, wanting attention, lonely, or feeling protective.

I much prefer to be with people and would be a great companion for a retired person or a home where my parent/s are home more than away.

I am reliably house trained, love treats, cuddling, burrowing under covers, am a very good sleeper, and am very excited by the short walks I’ve been able to take since my recovery.

Because I’m such a special girl, I will need a special home where my parent(s) are patient, willing to help me navigate my world, and are willing to make my immediate environment safe and accessible for me. If that sounds like you, apply today!
